description:
U by Urbeo proudly presents U Clay Farm, a residential development ideally located in Leopardstown, Dublin 18.

This exceptional scheme offers a selection of Studio, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments arranged around beautifully landscaped gardens, private roof terraces and luxury residents’ amenity spaces.

Key Features:

- A-rated energy-efficient apartments
- Spacious, light-filled layouts with excellent storage
- High-quality furnishings by Ventura Design
- Fully fitted contemporary kitchens
- Private landscaped gardens
- Five rooftop terraces with panoramic city views
- Parking available

Resident Amenities:

- Dedicated management team on call
- Onsite concierge (Monday–Friday)
- Residents’ lounge
- Meeting / study room
- Function room
- Outdoor rooftop workout station

Transport Links:

- 2-minute walk to The Gallops Luas (Green Line)
- Dublin Bus routes L27, S8 & 44 nearby
- Easy access to Dublin City Centre by Luas, bus, bike or car

Location Highlights:

- Short stroll to Leopardstown Shopping Centre
- Close to Carrickmines Park retail outlet (2 Luas stops)
- Excellent choice of primary & secondary schools nearby
- Surrounded by sports & leisure facilities including Westwood Club, Carrickmines Croquet & Lawn Tennis Club & Fernhill Park & Gardens

***Our team will endeavour to respond to all enquiries. However, this may not be possible in all cases due to the high volume of interest for the property and we wish you all the best with your property search.***
